Ankleshwar Rotary Education Society is promoted by an International NGO, the Rotary Club of Ankleshwar, and strongly supported by the world-renowned Agrochemical doyen, UPL Ltd., the university is committed to work with a philanthropic approach to impart world class education to students in the fields of Science, Engineering, Technology, and Management. Using research in science and technology for building a sustainable future for all and developing youth power of India through skill development for good employment is the vision of the university. The university moving ahead in this direction with an unassuming support from other industries, such as Sajjan India Ltd., Zydus Cadila, GRP Ltd, BEIL Infrastructure Ltd., Gharda Chemicals, Colourtex Ltd., and many others in Bharuch District. Aims and objective of ARES To carry on activities for the promotion of education and physical and cultural training keeping in view of the objectives of the Rotary international and without making any difference or distinction of caste, creed and/or religion. To carry on activities for promotion of health, hunger and humanity and to fight poverty, Illiteracy and hunger, keeping in view of the objectives of, the Rotary international and without Making difference or distinction of caste, creed and/or religion. To carry on public youth activities for the promotion of sports, education by way of healthy competition and humanitarian activities for all people belonging to all religions without making any difference or distinction of caste, creed and / or religion. To carry on activities for the promotion of friendship, brother-hood and knowledge without making difference or distinction of caste, creed and/or religion. To carry on activities for bringing mass awareness among the public in generaI of their duties as good citizens without making any difference or distinction of caste, creed and/or religion. To carry on activities for the promotion of education and research concerning the Ankleshwar and Bharuch region in particular and Gujarat State and India, in general, without making any difference or distinction of caste, creed and/or religion. To carry on other public charitable activities without making any difference or distinction of caste, creed and/or religion. To create infrastructure to facilitate society to meet aims and objectives of the Society. The basic academic philosophy of the Ankleshwar Rotary Education Society is to focus on Education in Engineering, Science, Management and Sustainable Technology. Financial support to the students from economically weaker family through its Scholarship Scheme. Felicitate students for their achievements in university exams as well as state and national level competitions Presently, Ankleshwar Education Society is managing UPL University of Sustainable Technology. UPL University of Sustainable Technology, the first university of Bharuch District, is a unique seat of Higher Education located amidst industries – small and big – near Ankleshwar, one of the biggest hubs of process industry in India. Recently established as a University but adequately experienced in technical education as a GTU affiliated Engineering College by the name Shroff. S. R. Rotary Institute of Chemical Technology (SRICT) , UPL University of Sustainable Technology is committed to industry focused education. The journey of UPL University of Sustainable Technology is started way back in 2011 with the establishment of SRICT conducting UG ( B.E. ) courses in engineering in affiliation with GTU and approval of AICTE, New Delhi. The institute has also developed two special industry focused courses. They are (i) Chemical Technology having four different specializations viz. Pharmaceutical Technology, Dyes & Pigments Technology, Polymer & Rubber Technology, and Glass & Ceramic Technology, (ii) Environmental Science & Technology. Both the disciplines of the UG course have a perfect blend of Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, and a concerned special Technology. For build a research culture, we started the PG ( M.E. ) courses in Chemical and Mechanical engineering in 2015 followed by a PG ( M.Sc.) course in Organic Chemistry in 2018 and that in Environmental Management in 2020 . From 2021, University has also started Diploma programs in Chemical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Electrical Engineering & Environment Engineering and B.E. Computer Engineering. Both institutes are providing quality education in the field of Engineering and Science respectively. SRICT is one of the top engineering institutes of Gujarat and SRICT –ISR is one of the most favorite PG centers for M.Sc. in South Gujarat. Both the institutes are providing 100 % placement to all eligible students. ARES management has decided to start a Diploma Programs in Information Technology and Post Graduate (M.E.) Program in Electrical Engineering and UG program (B.Sc.) Microbiology from academic year 2022-23. From 2022, we started Full time and part time Ph.D. Programs under Engineering, Science, Mathematics, Physical and English. We are also motivating research scholars for Interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary research. The forte of the institute is its expertise in excellent teaching practices, industry connects, and job placement to all its eligible students. Research and consultancy in Environmental projects is another salient feature that has been cultivated by the management among faculty members in a relatively short span of time. Excellent academics and personal care of students have made them outshine, many others in the university exams with awards of University Gold Medals many times. We, at University, are also serving many industries via our Schedule-1 Environmental Audit, Energy Audit, 5S (Workplace Management), R & D, Tailor-made Training Programs to Industries. We have NABL accredited Environmental lab, NBA Accredited Programs (BE Chemical Engineering, BE Environmental Science & Technology and BE Mechanical Engineering). Shroff. S. R. Rotary Institute of Chemical Technology (SRICT) is accredited by NAAC with B++. SRICT is also awarded with 4 Star (* * * *) from Gujarat State Institutional Ranking Framework (GSIRF) in 2021 and 2022. We, at University, having a Centre of Excellence in Process Safety which provides consultancy to Industries for 3D Modelling, Qualitative & Quantitative Risk Analysis Study, Process Hazard Identification, Safety Training, Certificate and Diploma courses to Students and Industry persons. Master of Engineering Electrical Engineering | UPL University of Sustainable Technology TEL: +91-9712177799 EMAIL: admin@upluniversity.ac.in UGC Proforma/Mandatory Disclosure Admission Inquiry Search Master of Engineering (Electrical Engineering) The Master of Electrical Engineering program, established in 2023, is a rigorously designed postgraduate offering that cultivates advanced intellectual depth and technical expertise across core domains, including Electrical Machines, Power System Protection, Electrical Instrumentation, and Power Electronics. The program is structured to integrate analytical rigor with applied engineering practice, preparing graduates to address complex and evolving technological challenges. The department is supported by advanced laboratory infrastructure, comprising dedicated facilities in Electrical Machines, Power Systems, High Voltage Engineering, and Embedded & Automation. These laboratories provide an immersive environment for experiential learning, enabling students to engage with contemporary tools, systems, and methodologies reflective of global engineering practices. The curriculum is forward-looking, research-informed, and aligned with international academic and industry standards, encompassing emerging areas such as Electric Mobility, Renewable and Sustainable Energy Systems, AI-driven Smart Grids, and Intelligent Automation. This ensures the development of globally competent engineers equipped with innovation-driven and solution-oriented mindsets. The department fosters a culture of academic excellence, scholarly inquiry, and interdisciplinary collaboration, supported by a distinguished faculty, cutting-edge computational resources, and modern technological infrastructure. It actively contributes to knowledge creation through funded research, industry partnerships, and consultancy in advanced engineering applications. A strong emphasis is placed on holistic professional development, facilitated through curated academic engagements including international-level workshops, technical colloquia, industry immersion programs, and expert interactions. Students are encouraged to undertake research-intensive projects and industry-linked assignments, nurturing critical thinking, innovation, and leadership capabilities. Through its commitment to excellence, innovation, and societal impact, the program aspires to develop globally competitive electrical engineers and future leaders capable of contributing meaningfully to technological advancement and sustainable development. The department provides a wide range of academic programs, such as Diploma, BE, ME, PGD, and PhD, that are intended to give students the practical skills and scientific understanding needed to tackle environmental and sustainability concerns. Modern labs at the department enable cutting-edge research and study in fields like soil, water, and air pollution, environmental monitoring, pollution control technologies, and environmental modelling. It gives researchers and students practical training with state-of-the-art environmental software, tools, and analytical methods. The department is also actively engaged in consultancy services and research projects addressing real-world environmental issues. These activities enable the department to collaborate closely with industries, government agencies and other stakeholders to develop effective solutions for pollution control and environmental management. Research publications, patents, and grants from both governmental and non-governmental organizations are all actively pursued by departmental faculties and students Furthermore, the department frequently hosts short-term training programs, seminars, workshops, and refresher courses in the field of environment & sustainability with the goal of improving technical proficiency and knowledge of regulatory staff, industry professionals, and environmental practitioners. The department also encourages students and scholars to actively participate in national and international conferences, seminars, and scientific forums, providing them with opportunities to present their research, interact with experts, and stay updated with the latest developments in environmental science and technology. Through such initiatives, the department strives to nurture competent environmental professionals and contribute meaningfully to sustainable development. The basic academic philosophy of the Shroff S.R. Rotary Institute of Chemical Technology is to focus on Chemical Technology (covering Chemical Engineering and other Chemical Technology Courses) as the Gujarat’s industrial strength lies in these areas besides Chemical Engineering. The other guiding philosophy is to create R & D infrastructure in these areas (including trained manpower) to meet the industrial needs of Gujarat. The current degree programmes are designed to provide flexible training for students to meet the future demands of the process industry. The diverse curricula and training offered make our graduates employable not only to the process industry but also to the other economic sectors, such as management consultancy, banking, finance and accountancy. SRICT Certificate Course for Non-Paint Technologists About the course This certificate course is helpful for employee from pigment and Paint industries. It gives technical knowledge of application of pigments in Paint sector. The Surface Coating is a growing industry and with the so many multinational OEM companies (MNC) in white good & Global automobile giants entering into Indian market along with growing urbanization there has been an increasing demand for qualified Paint Technologists. The department provides a wide range of academic programs, such as Diploma, BE, ME, PGD, and PhD, that are intended to give students the practical skills and scientific understanding needed to tackle environmental and sustainability concerns. Modern labs at the department enable cutting-edge research and study in fields like soil, water, and air pollution, environmental monitoring, pollution control technologies, and environmental modelling. It gives researchers and students practical training with state-of-the-art environmental software, tools, and analytical methods. The department is also actively engaged in consultancy services and research projects addressing real-world environmental issues. These activities enable the department to collaborate closely with industries, government agencies and other stakeholders to develop effective solutions for pollution control and environmental management. Research publications, patents, and grants from both governmental and non-governmental organizations are all actively pursued by departmental faculties and students Furthermore, the department frequently hosts short-term training programs, seminars, workshops, and refresher courses in the field of environment & sustainability with the goal of improving technical proficiency and knowledge of regulatory staff, industry professionals, and environmental practitioners. The department also encourages students and scholars to actively participate in national and international conferences, seminars, and scientific forums, providing them with opportunities to present their research, interact with experts, and stay updated with the latest developments in environmental science and technology. Through such initiatives, the department strives to nurture competent environmental professionals and contribute meaningfully to sustainable development. There is already a shortage of qualified engineers, which means higher salaries and more opportunities for those who are qualified. The job opportunities for graduates in the field of Mechanical Engineering are vast in technical fields. Any graduate/diploma holder who has successfully completed a course of engineering can get a job in almost every sector in India and abroad. Students get placed in industries such as Aeronautical, Chemical, Automobile, Electronics, and many others after completing the Mechanical Engineering course. Additionally, students can opt for BE/ME/MTech/MBA or any other higher studies after Engineering. Bachelor of Engineering (BE) in Mechanical Engineering is one of the finest and most popular courses. It is a four-year undergraduate program that deals with designing, thermal analysis, and manufacturing of any product that requires motion, energy, and force principles. The course prepares students to become mechanical engineers, who can work in various fields such as automobile, aeronautics, chemical, electronics, construction, petroleum, power, textile, and more. Mechanical engineers contribute significantly to technological advancements and global problem-solving. They help address some of the biggest challenges facing humanity, such as climate change, cybersecurity, aging populations, food security, clean water, and energy sustainability. A career in mechanical engineering, whether through diploma, undergraduate, or postgraduate studies, ensures a promising future with diverse opportunities and professional growth. Vision: To play an active role in producing globally competent mechanical engineers to make technologically proficient, innovative, enthusiastic, future leaders and responsible citizen possessing human values to contribute significantly towards meeting global challenges. To design and organise training programme to offer wide choice to industry and academia for their skills enhancement. 5. To promote faculty and staff members to become resourceful, innovative and through various development programmes. 6. To serve society through innovation and excellence. Programme Educational Objectives (PEOs) 1. To provide strong foundation in mechanical engineering related subjects. 2. To develop readiness for profession and higher education programmes. 3. To promote creativity and innovation among students and faculties. 4. To develop entrepreneurial skill among the students. 5. To provide realistic learning opportunity to the students through in plant training, industry defined projects (IDP), IV (Industrial visit), EL (Expert Lecture) and PLE (Peer Learning Experience). With a strong emphasis on industry-relevant training and sustainability, the course is ideal for individuals aspiring to enhance their technical capabilities and professional qualifications in the chemical processing sector. About the course This certificate course is helpful for Chemical plant operators of chemical industries. It gives technical knowledge of application of chemical engineering in chemical sectors. The syllabus includes chemical engineering concepts, safety and soft skill, networking, sustainability etc. This course will be beneficial for our students to get placement in Chemical industries as well. Course prerequisites and exemptions Due to the level of technical content, the general requirement is • 10th with 5 years of experience/12thwith 3 years Experience/ Dloma/B.Sc./M.Sc. Resources Lesson content is provided via notes and pdf files. Teaching Classroom and Laboratory Assessment One End Semester Examination will be conducted after completion of the course. The successful students will be awarded the certificate of course completion. Course Fee, enrolment and payment The course fee is Rs. 35,000/-. DD/Cheque payment is accepted in the name of “Ankleshwar Rotary Education Society,” Terms and conditions Full course fee must be paid at the time of registrations. Course Syllabus: Total hrs.(144 Hours) Unit Processes and Unit Operation: Chemical Process Calculations, Fluid Mechanics, Mechanical Operations, Mass Transfer, Chemical Reaction Engineering, Heat Transfer. Safety and Permit Induction Training: Elaboration on Induction training and terminology, Meaning of Hazard, Types of Hazards, Accidents, Incidents and Near-miss Incidences, emergencies. MSDS. Main points of the MSDS. Fire triangle, and prevention of the fire. Types of fires, Firefighting. Green rules and Red Rules. PPEs used in Chemical Industry, and Special PPEs Emergency, Preparedness to handle, emergencies, MOCK Drill etc. Occupational Safety and Process Safety. Electrical Safety, Static Electricity and Concept of Flameproof enclosures, Permit Systems. Housekeeping and 5S program. Role of operator in chemical plant, Loading and unloading operations, Standard Operating Procedure in industry, Worker benefits under various acts. Hardware (Basics) in Chemical Plant: List of Major Equipment used in Chemical Plants. Working Principles of the Equipment. Equipment of Choice for different Operations. MOC (Maternal of Construction) Piping and Fittings. Utilities (Electricity, Steam, Cooling water, Chilled water, Brine and Nitrogen) Basics of Instrumentation: Indicating Instruments, Alarms, Controllers, Interlocks, Brief on hardware involved. Sustainable Technology: Pillars of sustainability, Sustainable development, Global environmental issues-climate change and global warming, Carbon footprint and trading, Clean energy sources, clean energy sources-solar, wind, bio-fuels. Basics of Computer and Networking: Basics of Computer, MS Office, Computer Network and Internet, Digital handling, Digital logbook. Soft skills: Report writing, Email writing, Facing Interviews, Motivational Training. Course Outcomes: Upon successful completion, participants will: • Grasp fundamental principles of chemical plant operations. • Understand the operation and design of process equipment. • Gain insights into sustainable technologies and practices for industrial applications. • Develop a thorough understanding of mechanical operations in the process industry. • Learn to identify and mitigate process hazards and risks. • Conduct both qualitative and quantitative analyses of industrial process safety.
